presentation.summary: Enrich mainstream comics from a local Grand Comics Database dump, ComicVine, or Metron, with a filename fallback when no source answers.
presentation.description_markdown:
Resolves a comic to its series and issue from a local Grand Comics Database dump, ComicVine, or Metron, falls back to parsing the filename when none of them answer, and maps the result onto Silo metadata: title, series, number, count, volume, summary, creators, publisher, imprint, genres, tags, characters, teams, locations, age rating, and page information.

Embedded ComicInfo.xml is not read yet. Silo's metadata capability passes a title, a year, and provider IDs, not the archive, so the file inside a CBZ/CBR stays out of reach until a capability that hands over the file exists. The parser and a CLI for it are in the source tree, ready for that step.
presentation.setup_markdown:
Install the plugin, then add ComicInfo Metadata to a comic library's provider chain. The plugin has no bundled data, so configure at least one source:

**ComicVine** — set `comicvine_api_key` to a free API key from https://comicvine.gamespot.com/api/.

**Grand Comics Database (GCD)** — download the official SQLite dump yourself and save it where the plugin can read it:
1. Create a free account at https://www.comics.org and sign in.
2. Open https://www.comics.org/download/ and choose **Private Use**.
3. Download the SQLite dump, unpack it, and place the `.db` file at the path set in `gcd_dump_path` (for example `/config/gcd.db`).

The dump is about 6 GB and must be refreshed by downloading it again.

**Filename fallback** — with no source configured, the plugin can still read series, issue number, and year out of the file name; enable it with `enable_filename`.

capabilities.description: Finds mainstream comic series and issues in a local Grand Comics Database dump, ComicVine, or Metron, and enriches them with metadata, creators, and publication details.

global_config_schema.title: Grand Comics Database
global_config_schema.description: Use a local GCD SQLite dump for offline matching. Default on when a path is set.

global_config_schema.title: GCD database path
global_config_schema.description: Full path to the extracted GCD SQLite .db file (e.g. /config/gcd.db). Required to use GCD.

global_config_schema.title: ComicVine
global_config_schema.description: Query the ComicVine API for issue metadata. Requires a free API key.

global_config_schema.title: ComicVine API key
global_config_schema.description: Free key from https://comicvine.gamespot.com/api/. Stored encrypted by Silo.

global_config_schema.title: Metron
global_config_schema.description: Query the Metron comic database. Off by default; requires an API token.

global_config_schema.title: Metron API token
global_config_schema.description: Token from your metron.cloud account page. Stored encrypted by Silo.

global_config_schema.title: Filename fallback
global_config_schema.description: Infer series, issue number, and year from the archive filename when nothing else matches.
